en: Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 7.5. Saṅkiliṭṭhattika (The Triplet on the Corrupted)

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement (*na-saṅkiliṭṭha-asaṅkilesika*), a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) ... [etc. ...
Dependent on a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement (*na-asaṅkiliṭṭha-saṅkilesika*), a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement arises by way of root condition ... [etc. ...
Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root-condition, there are twenty-nine; in the case of object-condition, twenty-four ... pe ... in the case of resultant-condition, twenty-one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance-condition, twenty-nine.
